rules: Risk-On si tendance positive et Composite ≥ 45 et Credit/Vol ≥ 35
Risk-Off si Composite ≤ 40 et tendance négative
Risk-Off si Credit/Vol ≤ 35 et tendance négative

indicators.label: Initial Claims
indicators.why: Fast labor-market stress gauge. Lower is better for risk assets.

indicators.label: Continuing Claims
indicators.why: Confirms whether labor weakness is becoming persistent.

indicators.label: Consumer Sentiment
indicators.why: Consumer confidence proxy and cyclical demand signal.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.why: Broad financial conditions measure. Easier conditions support risk.

indicators.label: 10Y-3M curve
indicators.why: Cycle / recession signal via the yield curve slope.

indicators.label: Breadth proxy RSP/SPY
indicators.why: Internal market breadth proxy using equal-weight vs cap-weight.

indicators.label: Copper / Gold
indicators.why: Cyclical growth versus safe-haven demand proxy.

indicators.label: 10Y breakeven inflation
indicators.why: Checks whether long-term inflation expectations remain anchored.

indicators.label: 5Y breakeven inflation
indicators.why: More reactive market inflation expectations measure.

indicators.label: CPI YoY anchor score
indicators.why: Realized inflation distance from a 2.25% comfort zone.

indicators.label: US 10Y real yield
indicators.why: Higher real yields pressure equity valuations.

indicators.label: 10Y-2Y curve
indicators.why: Additional cycle signal from the yield curve.

indicators.label: 2Y minus Fed Funds proxy
indicators.why: Proxy for expected policy path versus current policy rate.

indicators.label: VIX
indicators.why: Implied equity fear gauge on the S&P 500.

indicators.label: VXN - VIX
indicators.why: Relative stress in Nasdaq vs broad equity market.
